# OINK Theme Assets

Palette and typography adapted from [pgsty/oink](https://github.com/pgsty/oink),
tag `v1.2.0`, commit `f8f476e660cf053a2645b7b923ae8d08d5448fce`.

Source files: `assets/scss/td/_brand.scss`, `_presets.scss`,
`_experimental-presets.scss`, and `_tokens-typography.scss`.

AgentLab maps the four palettes to its existing semantic tokens. Geometry is
adapted to existing controls; letter spacing stays at zero. The appearance
controller is an independent implementation, without Hugo or Bootstrap.

`LICENSE` and `NOTICE` retain OINK / Docsy attribution. The self-hosted Latin
font subsets are distributed under their accompanying OFL licenses in `fonts/`.
Chinese text uses platform fonts. No third-party font requests are made.
